orm: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic
normal_binding: ONE Finish_Normal per slot; sample FinishBake UV1; retain UV0 tangents; no normal stacking

housing.coating: near-black cast housing with local pits and silver wear

lens.profile: LightProfile R energy, G thin-shell mask, B reserved zero; emission uses R only. Existing hot range .55-.90 and strength 24.
lens.representation: Real Housing holder/bracket and Lens bulb/concave mirror under thin transparent amber dome; no projected interior
lens.thin_shell: Mix opaque optical BSDF with pow(BaseColor,.45)-tinted Transparent at G * .91 * (1-Fresnel(1.49)); actual interior geometry preserves parallax. ORM B gives mirror metallic=1.
lens.rotation: Rigid local-Z material vertex rotation of Lens G<.5 and Housing z>=.177m/radius<.055m, common phase; shell fixed. See handoff.

lod_textures: Separate LOD charts in the same maps; every LOD painted and finish-baked
frame: metres, +X forward, Z up; origin base underside for 08/12/13, mounting plane for 07/09
uv_beacon: 08 one continuous +X toward +Y outer dome island in each LOD; separate real bulb and mirror islands. Do not sweep/wrap the entire atlas.

light_anchor.text: Point, 80 cd, amber/2200 K, attenuation 8 m; anchor (0,0,0.25) m. Mirror faces +X at rest; Claude supplies the material sweep.
